_comment: Copy of the settings. SETUP.bat copies this to config.json. Fill in the keys below. Never share config.json.
_images_help: Optional. An OpenAI API key enables 'make me a picture of ...'.
_email_help: Gmail: smtp_username is the Gmail address that SENDS, smtp_app_password is a 16-letter App Password (Google Account > Security > 2-Step Verification > App passwords). send_to is where reports go.
